experiment: R -- replication of the stage-1 AdaBN + SA-TM heading gain on the MAV6D VAL split
statement: Written before any val ground truth was read in this experiment: no val member dump, no sealed val ground truth and no val evaluation exist at this time (asserted). The val split was inspected only through seq / frame / cls of index.pkl (overlap_check.py).

spec.question: Does AdaBN KZ (BN statistics re-estimated on real MAV6D TRAIN crops; the exact stage-1 checkpoints) + SA-TM beat the original KZ + SA-TM on the MAV6D VAL split?
spec.positions: pure-sim release_20260920 ramp_s0..s4 5-ensemble + flip TTA + causal100 temporal background + label-free self-calibrated lwh (val images, conf >= 0.7, interval 2) + KZ zoom 95 crops; one GPU dump (dump_members_repl.py --split val --pos sim --members kz); the AdaBN members are forwarded on the SAME recorded crops (replay_members_repl.py), so positions / detections / crops are identical by construction (asserted)

arms.KZ: release_20260923/kz_s0..s4.pth, SA-TM of the 5 members at the recorded deployed read cell (kz_fuse_offline.fuse_subset SATM, deployed decoder, fallback = dumped rotation)
arms.BN: kzst1/adabn/kz_s{0..4}_adabn.pth (sha256 = stage-1 json), read cell = argmax of the 5-member mean hm in the recorded 5x5 window, same SA-TM code

spec.frames: all val frames; metric frames = greedy 1 m matched frames of dump_real_preds (identical in both arms); the top detection carries the arm rotation when it is the hook cell, else the frame is unchanged (stage-1 rule)
spec.heading: fold-180 heading error min(a, 180 - a), a = |atan2(E[1,0], E[0,0])|, E = R_gt^T R_pred (annot_audit/summarize_dumps.stats); statistic = median over matched frames

primary.delta: median heading(BN) - median heading(KZ) over all matched val frames
primary.ci: sequence-cluster bootstrap (kz_fuse_offline.boot_draws / cluster_boot: resample the val sequences with replacement, statistic = delta on the pooled frames), B = 10000, seed 20261003; upper bound = 97.5th percentile
primary.seq_rule: per val sequence with >= 1 matched frame: median(BN) - median(KZ) < 0 counts as improved (ties = not improved); fraction = improved / sequences with >= 1 matched frame

guardrails.tilt: median tilt (angle between body z axes, summarize_dumps.stats) over matched frames, BN - KZ <= +0.3 deg
guardrails.ads: repository LAA3D_ADS, profile indoor (tools/eval_camnorm.ads_eval, as KZ_SUMMARY), value parsed from the report (2 decimals); BN - KZ >= 0.00 ("not worse")

decision.replicated: all three primary criteria AND both guardrails pass
decision.primary_only: all primary criteria pass but a guardrail fails -> not replicated as a deployable gain

validity_checks_before_ground_truth: byte copies of kz_fuse_offline / kzst_common / dump_kz_members / adabn_kz unchanged (sha256)
KZ dump: split val, interval 1, pos_set sim, members = release KZ, finished, 2336 frames = all val frames
BN file: arm adabn, replay check passed, crops copied from the KZ npz (sha256), checkpoints sha256 == stage-1 AdaBN json
positions / crops / geometry fields identical between the two member files; same top detection per frame

deployed decoder replicated on the KZ dump: top conf == hook peak on >= 99 % of detected frames (others stay unchanged in both arms), PnP(recorded vector) == dumped rotation and offline C0 == dumped rotation on >= 99.9 % of hook frames
report_only: per class (phantom4 / mavic2) heading, <10 / <20 deg, tilt, 10deg10cm, ADD(0.5d)
E5 strata of the KZ arm
comparison with the stage-1 TEST effect (-3.54 deg)

seq_better_needed: 10 of 16 val sequences (if all 16 have >= 1 matched frame; otherwise ceil(0.60 x n))
planned_commands: replay_members_repl.py --src-tag val_kz --tag val_adabn                (GPU, after the first)
caveats_known_before_data: val sequences are held out from the official MAV6D train list by sequence; every val scene (mavic2/02, mavic2/03, phantom4/01, phantom4/02) also occurs in train and therefore among the AdaBN re-estimation frames (as do all test scenes)
the self-calibrated lwh of the val dump is estimated on val images themselves (label-free; identical for both arms)
16 sequences only: the sequence-cluster interval is wide; mavic2/02/0202 has 16 frames
